acquisition method: The mass spectrometer was operated in positive ionization mode using a data dependent acquisition method.
fragmentation method: with both collision induced dissociation (CID) and high energy collision dissociation (HCD) fragmentation.
instrument: analyzed using a LTQ-Orbitrap Fusion Lumos mass spec-trometer
ionization type: The mass spectrometer was operated in positive ionization mode
reduction reagent: All buffers were supplemented with spermidine (1:1000), beta-mercaptoethanol (1:1000)
